name: key_rotation
title: How one sending direction changes its root
summary: The sender begins before its epoch fills, uses the old root within its limits until the acknowledgement verifies, then sends with the new root. The other direction rotates independently.

nodes.title: Sender
nodes.note: Starts rotation at half the epoch's byte, record or 500 ms lifetime limit. Later data waits if the old epoch runs out.

nodes.title: Receiver
nodes.note: Checks the old-root proof, contributes fresh hybrid material and confirms the candidate new root. A malformed or late exchange ends the session.
